incident: Lance migration stopped on a typed context overflow after repeated streaming failures.
findings: The default three native stream retries accumulated partial reasoning: provider request sizes grew from 13237236 to 22342717 bytes before a context rejection.
The former three-hour audit remained bound to an obsolete goal and skipped the active thread's replacement goal.
Native local compaction repeatedly received HTTP 400 context rejections while removing only one small oldest history item per request.
Root storage remained healthy at approximately 171 GiB available; this was not a reproduced storage failure.

shared_changes.native_gpt_compaction: Omit only provenance-tagged GPT opaque assistant reasoning with no visible summary/content; explicitly mark the omission in the summary request. Preserve original records and visible messages/tool results. Normal inference retains owned reasoning.
shared_changes.alerting: Recovery guard failures write a structured alert and an actionable cron stderr notice; healthy checks clear the alert.

deployment.lance_watcher: Replaced obsolete three-hour model audit with the existing deterministic one-minute recovery watcher; follows goal replacement only within the pinned native thread.
deployment.watcher_safeguards: Explicit pauses, completion, budgets, detached Screen identity, pending drafts, bounded recovery allowances and a shared lock remain enforced.
deployment.other_processes: No unrelated running session was reloaded. Shared defaults and compaction transformation apply to new launches and reloads.

live_verification.failed_compaction_intervention: After confirming repeated size rejections, saved a private receipt, cancelled that failed loop gracefully, reloaded the same thread, and restored only the goal paused by this repair.

key_regressions: Installed Codex compacts proactively after simulated near-limit usage, then recovers from a socket failure while preserving an executed side effect exactly once.
Single native retry exhausts after two failed attempts; terminal denials and user cancellation remain terminal.
Native GPT compaction keeps visible history, agent messages, unknown/foreign ciphertext and visible reasoning summaries unchanged; it does not mutate saved input.
The SDK sends one small compaction inference with an explicit omission marker, exact visible tool-result history, authorized source model and real accounting.
Attached native Screen recovery, replaced-goal recovery, pause/budget/draft guards, and cron stderr alerts.
validation.optional_long_running_sdk_tests: Not rerun; regular SDK transport checks, installed-native checks and live same-thread compaction were verified.

limits: The local harness cannot guarantee that the remote service never disconnects.
Earlier compaction and a reasoning-free visible-history summary reduce the observed overflow paths; arbitrary visible tool output can still exceed provider limits.
Opaque assistant reasoning without visible text is excluded from GPT compaction requests, so summaries rely on visible conversation and tool evidence. Original records remain available locally.
Recovery stays bounded and does not override explicit user pauses or terminal auth/policy/quota errors.
